itemText: Store the fusion switch and the chosen model list in the owner's admin settings, validated to two to five distinct models from the known model list.
Add a Fusion mode section to the web settings page and to the iPhone and Mac Settings, with an on/off switch, a model picker limited to five and the estimated cost per source shown.
Run the extraction once per chosen model in parallel, reusing the model comparison runner, and save each returned card as a pending card with its model id.
Group near-identical cards from different models into one candidate that lists every model that produced it, and keep a failed model from blocking the rest.
Show fusion candidates in web triage with model badges and a keep or reject choice per candidate.
Show the same candidates with model badges in iPhone triage and in the Mac triage view.
Save the model ids of the candidate with every triage keep or reject, reusing the existing feedback by model records where they fit.
Add a per-model kept and rejected count to the owner statistics API and show it on the web and iPhone Statistics screens.

Depends on fusion-settings.
